title: Grade 5 Science — Thu, Jun 04
description: The Skeletal System — Day 4 of 5: Caring for bones and muscles
subject: science

questions.question: Sitting and standing straight with the back upright is called good:
questions.explanation: Good posture means keeping the body, especially the back, in the correct upright position.

questions.question: Carrying a very heavy school bag on one shoulder can harm your:
questions.explanation: A heavy bag on one side can bend the backbone and spoil posture.

questions.question: The mineral that keeps bones strong is:
questions.explanation: Calcium, found in milk and leafy vegetables, keeps bones strong.

questions.question: Which vitamin helps the body use calcium and is made with the help of sunlight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D, made when sunlight falls on our skin, helps the body use calcium for strong bones.

questions.question: A crack or break in a bone is called a:
questions.explanation: When a bone breaks or cracks, it is called a fracture.

questions.question: A doctor may put a hard cover called a ____ around a broken bone to help it heal.
questions.explanation: A plaster cast holds the broken bone still so it can heal in the correct position.

questions.question: Regular exercise is good for muscles because it makes them:
questions.explanation: Exercise makes muscles stronger, more flexible and healthier.

questions.question: A painful, sudden tightening of a muscle is called a:
questions.explanation: A cramp is a sudden, painful tightening of a muscle.

questions.question: Which set of foods is best for strong bones and muscles?
questions.explanation: Milk, eggs and green vegetables give calcium and protein needed for bones and muscles.

questions.question: Why should we warm up before playing sports?
options: To prepare muscles and avoid injury
questions.explanation: Warming up gets muscles ready and helps prevent cramps and injuries.

questions.question: A twisting injury to a joint, stretching its ligaments, is called a:
questions.explanation: A sprain happens when a joint is twisted and its ligaments are stretched or torn.

questions.question: Sitting straight while studying helps protect your:
questions.explanation: Good sitting posture keeps the backbone healthy and prevents back pain.

questions.question: Getting some morning sunlight helps the body make vitamin D, which is good for:
questions.explanation: Sunlight helps make vitamin D, which keeps bones strong.

questions.question: Which habit is BAD for the health of bones and muscles?
options: Sitting in a slouched position for hours
questions.explanation: Slouching for long hours harms posture and the backbone.

questions.question: Why is rest important after heavy exercise?
options: It is a waste of time
Muscles need rest to recover and grow stronger
Bones rest but muscles do not need it
questions.explanation: Rest lets tired muscles recover and become stronger.
